finalText:
**`Redis` went down and took the service with it.**

| time (UTC) | event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused, cache off |
| 02:14:10 | store reads hit `TimeoutError` at 5000ms |
| 02:29:12 | queue depth passes max 500 |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `supervisor` killed api, service down |

All 13 reconnect tries failed with `ECONNREFUSED`. [logs/app.log](logs/app.log) ends there, no recovery. Note the log is dated 2026-07-04, not last night.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refuses connections.
